acceptanceCriteria: Each harness.py case expects the specific refusal code its guard emits
Cases that genuinely share a refusal are marked non-discriminating as in the daily-loop harness
A test shows that a wrong-guard refusal fails the case
body: Lane tasks-review-1021i (PR #1456, V1-0161) gave daily-loop harness cases L3/L5/L6 their own expected refusals. benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/harness.py still expects the shared NOT_COMPLETE refusal, so a case passes even when the wrong guard fires.
title: benchmarks: untouched-repository-v1 harness.py still collapses distinct refusals into one shared NOT_COMPLETE, so its cases cannot discriminate
